description: A multi-party ceasefire framework advances; officials from three sides go on the record.

clips.speaker: NETANYAHU
clips.text: We will not accept any arrangement that leaves the tunnels intact.

clips.speaker: BLINKEN
clips.text: This is the closest the parties have come in eleven months, and we intend to keep them at the table.

clips.speaker: SPEAKER_01
clips.text: For the families waiting, every hour of this negotiation is another hour of not knowing.

notes: Three quotes tied to one story so they must land in a single block; checks even distribution within that block.

description: The central bank holds rates as the shekel slides; a governor, an analyst, and a small-business owner weigh in.

clips.speaker: YARON
clips.text: We are holding, but we are watching the currency day by day.

clips.speaker: SPEAKER_01
clips.text: The market wanted a cut and did not get one, and you can see that in the afternoon selloff.

clips.speaker: SPEAKER_02
clips.text: I price my inventory in dollars now. I have no choice.

notes: Three clips of descending formality; should be paced through the block, not stacked.
